macros.name: AddAssociatedCounters
macros.doc: This command adds some counters to the associated counter list for a specific driver counter – if this list does not exists, the LaTeX run will be stopped.

macros.name: IsAssociatedCounter
macros.doc: This commands tests, whether a given counter name is an associated counter and expands correspondingly the true or the false branch.

macros.name: IsAssociatedToCounter
macros.doc: This macro checks, whether a counter is associated to a particular given driver counter and expands the corresponding branch.

macros.name: IsDriverCounter
macros.doc: This commands tests, whether a given counter name is a driver counter and expands correspondingly the true or the false branch.

macros.name: IsSuspendedCounter
macros.doc: This command checks, whether a counter is suspended, i.e. not updated at all and expands the corresponding branches.

macros.name: LastAddedToCounter
macros.doc: This command has no arguments and expands to the name of the counter which was used last in \addtocounter.

macros.name: LastSteppedCounter
macros.doc: This command has no arguments and expands to the name of the counter which was stepped last using \stepcounter.

macros.name: PrettyPrintCounterName
macros.doc: This command just prints a counter name with frame.

macros.name: RemoveAssociatedCounter
macros.doc: This command removes a counter from the existing list for a driver counter, i.e. the counter will not be increased any longer by \stepcounter.

macros.name: RemoveAssociatedCounters
macros.doc: This command removes the comma-separated-value list of counters from the existing list for a driver counter, i.e. the counters will not be increased any longer by \stepcounter.

macros.name: ResumeSuspendedCounters
macros.doc: This command has no arguments and revokes the suspension of all counters.

macros.name: setcounter
macros.doc: This command behaves like the standard macro \setcounter, but has an additional optional 1st argument.
